title: Sunset Niagara-on-the-Lake Small Group Wine Tour with Dinner
includes: Pick Up & Drop off at your Niagara Falls or Niagara On The Lake Accommodation
Gratuities For Tour Guide & Dinner Staff (not included)
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the wonderful wines of Niagara-on-the-Lake, Ontario, Canada and culinary greatness on this 5.5-hour tour to 3 separate wineries. Enjoy tastings of three or four wines at each stop followed by a wonderful dinner in Niagara Falls. Your tour will begin with pick up at your Niagara Falls or Niagara On The Lake accommodation.
Our first stop includes a full and in depth tasting of a large winery estate. You will find yourself totally engaged in the wine making production, tasting and education. Immerse yourself in Niagara Wine culture, as you enjoy and explore this structured tasting.
Learn about the winemaking process and the wines themselves at 2 more winery stops, while discovering each wine’s unique tasting notes. Our "Sunset Tour" is sure to impress. 
After your third winery your guide will wisk you off to Eighty Eight South in Niagara Falls, here you will enjoy a 3 course (included)
